headline: Priority 1 is done and the 3D speed study is done. In 2D, cost and accuracy do not depend on the mesh, and accuracy improves with bank width up to r = 384. In 3D, cost is also flat in the mesh, but a spectral full-order solver is faster at equal accuracy. Priority 2 (baselines, 2D full-solver comparison) is starting.

lanes.name: Priority 1 scaling
lanes.what: 2D cost/accuracy vs r and mesh; 3D kernels. 1.9 GPU-h.
